description: Saves a new TuneWorks setup for a vehicle. Deletes are not supported.

performedBy.description: Person who performed the setup. If omitted, TuneWorks uses the connected user name/email.

setupData.description: Setup fields such as setup goals, overall weight/balance, tire summary, front/rear ride height, front/rear total toe, per-corner tires, pressures, alignment, ride height, springs, dampers, corner weights, brake/balance, aero, electronics, and notes.

setupDate.description: Setup date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Natural date strings are accepted but YYYY-MM-DD is preferred.

name: create_setup

outputSchema.description: TuneWorks app object create/update result with the saved object and connected user.

status.description: Result status such as ok, created, updated, sent, auth_required, or confirmation_required.

tool.description: TuneWorks MCP tool name that produced this result.

title: Create setup
